title: Grateful Dead Live at Hollywood Palladium on 1972-09-09
lineage: AUD > MR > Cassette (unknown gen) > NAK DR3 > AUDACITY > CD Wave > FLAC16

ai_review.summary: Audience‑recorded tape delivers a high‑energy 1972 show with a smoking Truckin → Other One jam, captured in surprisingly good crowd‑rich sound.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its relentless drive, especially the extended Truckin → The Other One sequence that many reviewers call better than famous London ’72 shows. Though it’s an audience recording, the mix is clearer than most 1972 AUD tapes and the lively Southern California crowd adds a vivid ambience.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance with high energy and standout jams outweighs only modest recording clarity; overall enjoyment is very high.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Decent clarity for a 1972 audience tape, better than most contemporaneous recordings. Crowd ambience is vivid and lively, though the sound lacks the crispness of dedicated soundboard sources.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Shows a solid flow with a powerful second‑set jam; crowd interaction is highlighted throughout, creating an engaging live atmosphere.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for being "completely on" and exploring a wide range of playing during the Truckin → Other One stretch.
